accommodation: Static caravans in three grades, 2-3 bedrooms, sleeping 4-8
parking: Blue Badge spaces at the main complex; general parking not described
beachAccess: Direct access to the Towans beach, including a wheelchair-accessible route near the main restaurant

overview: A large Haven holiday park on the dunes above St Ives Bay near Hayle, with caravans in several grades and a busy entertainment complex. It backs directly onto the Towans, giving direct access to the beach.
surfTripFit: Direct beach access onto the Towans is a real plus for surfers, though the park is built around family entertainment.
